prompts.name: hero
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE standalone complete full-body Codekin mascot PNG, genuinely transparent background. Input1 is the approved 3D animation character STYLE AND IDENTITY reference. Input2 is ONLY a pose guide from the earlier flat concept. Match input1's soft rounded sculpted vinyl 3D illustration, ivory warm head, charcoal oval eyes, orange folded-page corner on SCREEN RIGHT forehead, vivid orange short overalls, ivory limbs, cream rounded chest badge carrying dark forest-green rounded lowercase c with orange folded tip. Same character proportions and materials as animation. NOT flat vector, NOT crude cubic Blender shapes, NOT robotic. Gentle upper-left studio lighting, subtle material shading on the character, no ground plane or exterior cast shadow. Full head, both hands, both feet entirely visible with generous transparent margins. No captions, no typography, no watermark, no palette swatches, no other characters. Output only ONE character on a square canvas.
Pose: match the large main mascot on input2: standing with warm closed-mouth smile, one open mitten hand reaching toward viewer invitingly, opposite hand at hip, slight friendly lean. Maintain rounded 3D hand and gentle expression.
